rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact neighborhood mass with one dominant carved void, a clear hierarchy between the outer shell and the open center, and a legible relationship to the blue access edge through the ground-level opening/seam. It is coherent across views and avoids the failure mode of being intelligible only in one projection. The silhouette is slightly stepped but still continuous enough to feel like one massing rule rather than arbitrary cake-tiering. Programmatically it can plausibly support neighborhood living / mixed-use because it offers an active threshold, public void, and calm upper body. The massing is not perfect—its section is still somewhat generic and could more strongly articulate a ground-to-upper hierarchy—but it passes the hard semantic fit for the brief.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More pavilion/civic than residential-commercial; avoid copying the scalloped roof language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part civic massing with a carved central void and bridge-like connector; useful as a precedent for a legible public cut through a compact neighborhood volume.
